name: Liswarr
description: The Liswarr was a Wookiee gunship owned by Doshanalawook, a Trandoshan who earned the nickname "Chainbreaker" for her activities freeing Wookiees from captivity. In 3 ABY, Doshanalawook's clutchmate, Bossk'wassak'Cradossk, boarded the ship in an attempt to capture her, though she escaped and was able to secure a promise from Bossk that he would not hunt Wookiees ever again.
